{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Safeguarding transportation infrastructure is critical to homeland security.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"An integrated, flexible transportation system must be developed and sustained in partnership between state and local governments and the federal government.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The private sector should share responsibilities with state and local governments and the federal government in developing and sustaining a transportation system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More prudent stewardship of the Highway Trust Fund is needed to restore the program's purchasing power.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Highway Trust Fund should ensure it will meet the changing needs of a mobile nation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Bipartisanship is needed to modernize Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The last four presidential terms have included seeking bipartisan cooperation to modernize Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid, but it has not been forthcoming.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The public demands constructive action to modernize Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to provide constructive action to modernize Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to put Social Security on a sound fiscal basis.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The ratio of workers to retirees will shift from 3.3 workers per retiree today to 2.1 workers per retiree by 2034.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Under the current system, younger workers will not be able to depend on Social Security as part of their retirement plan.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The solution to Social Security's fiscal issues should give workers control over, and a fair return on, their contributions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"No changes to the Social Security system should adversely affect any current or near-retiree.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Comprehensive Social Security reform should include the opportunity to freely choose to create personal investment accounts which are distinct from and supplemental to the overall Social Security system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
